message.content:
Here are some top-rated sushi spots in Los Angeles that consistently receive rave reviews:

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Highlights |
|------------|--------------|------------|
| **Sushi Gen** | Little Tokyo | Classic omakase, fresh fish, intimate setting |
| **Nobu Malibu** | Malibu (just outside LA) | Celebrity‑famous, high‑end fusion, ocean view |
| **KazuNori** | West Hollywood | Affordable, creative rolls, great for casual dining |
| **Sushi Zo** | Downtown LA | Omakase with a modern twist, seasonal ingredients |
| **Matsuhisa** | Beverly Hills | Chef Nobu’s flagship, upscale experience |

If you’re looking for a more budget‑friendly option, **KazuNori** offers excellent quality at a fraction of the price. For an unforgettable omakase experience, **Sushi Gen** or **Sushi Zo** are highly recommended. Enjoy your meal!
